from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, re
inputs=Path('/inputs')
out=Path('/work/README.md')

# Snapshot protected inputs for post-write verification.
all_inputs=sorted((p for p in inputs.iterdir() if p.is_file()), key=lambda p:p.name)
before={p.name:(p.stat().st_size, p.stat().st_mtime_ns, hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()) for p in all_inputs}

prefix=(inputs/'README.md').read_bytes()
# Required UTF-8 source/output.
prefix.decode('utf-8')
assert prefix.endswith(b'\n')
files=sorted((p for p in inputs.glob('*-*.md') if p.is_file()), key=lambda p:p.name)
rows=[]
for p in files:
    title=None
    for line in p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
        if line.startswith('# '):
            title=line[2:].strip()
            break
    if title is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f'No level-one heading in {p}')
    rows.append(f'| [{p.name}](../inputs/{p.name}) | .md | {title} |')
section='\n## Reference index\n\n| File | Type | Description |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n'+'\n'.join(rows)+'\n'
expected=prefix+section.encode('utf-8')
out.write_bytes(expected)

# Validate exact content and protected inputs unchanged.
actual=out.read_bytes()
assert actual == expected
assert actual.startswith(prefix)
assert actual[len(prefix):] == section.encode('utf-8')
assert actual.endswith((rows[-1]+'\n').encode('utf-8'))
after={p.name:(p.stat().st_size, p.stat().st_mtime_ns, hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()) for p in all_inputs}
assert after == before
print(f'Wrote and verified {out}: {len(actual)} bytes, {len(rows)} rows')
print('rows:', [p.name for p in files])
